I have used this screenshot app for a long time, and most of its interactions match how I already work. It does need a little setup the first time. Mine saves to Downloads and copies to the clipboard at the same time, then floats the capture in the bottom-left corner for a few seconds — if I want to highlight or annotate, I click that little window; if I don't, it goes away on its own.

It suggests keeping the system screenshot shortcut, which I also think is the right default. The OCR and the screen recording are both worth having.
